other_conditions: Must be studying in a government-run or government-aided school in West Bengal.
Must be a permanent resident of West Bengal.
Must live at least 2 km away from the school.
Must have at least 60% attendance in the last academic year.
Must not already own a bicycle.
Must be enrolled in class IX to XII.
benefits_summary: Provides free bicycles to eligible students, improving school attendance, health, and mobility while reducing dropout rates.
